name: voteaxis
description: Voteaxis monorepo — Next.js marketing site + Flutter app (iOS/Android) + Bun API server
author: Greigh Studios LLC

scripts.setup: bun install --cwd web && cd mobile && flutter pub get
scripts.build: cd mobile && GRADLE_OPTS="$GRADLE_OPTS --enable-native-access=ALL-UNNAMED" flutter build apk && flutter build ios
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd server typecheck && bun run --cwd web typecheck
scripts.lint: bun run typecheck && bun run --cwd web lint && cd mobile && flutter analyze
scripts.test: bun test --cwd server && bun test --cwd web && cd mobile && flutter test
